title: The Los Angeles Leaf Blower Wars

sentences.zh: 这里是百分之九十九隐形。
这里是百分之九十九隐形。

sentences.en: The leaf blower is one of the most hated objects in the modern world.
sentences.zh: 吹叶机是现代社会中最遭人恨的物品之一。

sentences.en: If you've lived pretty much anywhere in America in the last 40 years,
sentences.zh: 如果你在过去四十年里在美国的任何地方生活过，

sentences.en: you probably know their motorized whine.
sentences.zh: 你可能对它们那马达的轰鸣声不陌生。

sentences.en: They're loud, they pollute, and how important is a leafless lawn anyway?
sentences.zh: 它们噪音大、污染重，而且话说回来，没有落叶的草坪究竟有多重要？

sentences.en: In a lot of towns and cities, the gas-powered leaf blower has been banned.
sentences.zh: 在许多城镇和城市中，汽油驱动的吹叶机已被禁止使用。

sentences.en: In others, there are strict guidelines on where and when they can be used.
sentences.zh: 在其他地方，对于在哪里以及何时可以使用它们也有着严格的规定。

sentences.en: But in Los Angeles, California, the leaf blower has never gone quiet.
sentences.zh: 但在加利福尼亚州洛杉矶，吹叶机的声音却从未停歇。

sentences.en: That's reporter Phil Corbett from a podcast called The Wind.
sentences.zh: 这是来自名为《风》的播客节目的记者菲尔·科bett。

sentences.en: In 2024, the state of California banned the sale of gas-powered leaf blowers.
sentences.zh: 在2024年，加利福尼亚州禁止销售汽油驱动的吹叶机。

sentences.en: But this most recent development is just the latest shot in the Los Angeles leaf blower wars.
sentences.zh: 但最近这一进展只是洛杉矶吹叶机大战中的最新一轮交锋。

sentences.en: This is a fight that goes back decades.
sentences.zh: 这是一场持续了几十年的争斗。

sentences.en: A fight that's kicked up questions about labor rights, environmental concerns, and ideas of beauty.
sentences.zh: 一场引发了关于劳工权益、环保担忧以及审美观念等诸多疑问的争斗。

sentences.en: In 1970s Los Angeles, it was common for people to hose down their driveways.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪70年代的洛杉矶，人们用水管冲洗车道是很常见的事。

sentences.en: Homeowners, renters, and gardeners would wash dirt and leaves and whatever else out onto the street.
sentences.zh: 房主、租户和园丁会把泥土、树叶以及其他杂物冲到街上。

sentences.en: But a serious drought in 1976 and 77 spurred many Californians to start saving water
sentences.zh: 但在1976年和1977年的严重旱灾促使许多加州人开始节约用水，

sentences.en: and stop hosing everything down all the time.
sentences.zh: 并且不再一直用水管冲洗所有东西。

sentences.en: And as it just so happened, to meet this moment, a new piece of machinery was introduced to America.
sentences.zh: 正巧在这个时候，为了适应这种形势，一种新型机械被引入了美国。

sentences.en: There's a lot of things we like to do outdoors, like golf, gardening, and backpacking with Echo.
sentences.zh: 有很多我们喜欢在户外做的事情，比如打高尔夫、园艺，还有背着Echo背包去远足。

sentences.en: The Japanese company Echo debuted what they called the cleanup machine.
sentences.zh: 日本Echo公司推出了他们所谓的清理机。

sentences.en: In fall, it rounds up a yard full of leaves in no time.
sentences.zh: 在秋天，它能在极短时间内把满院子的树叶扫成一堆。

sentences.en: We use it year-round for garden grooming, sidewalk, patio, and driveway sweeping.
sentences.zh: 我们全年都用它来打理花园、清扫人行道、庭院和车道。

sentences.en: Works great for snow blowing, too.
Originally invented as a crop dusting device in 1947,
sentences.zh: 它最初在1947年是被作为农药喷洒设备发明的，

sentences.en: Echo soon realized that this machine had some serious leaf-moving properties.
sentences.zh: Echo不久便意识到这种机器具有很强的吹叶性能。

sentences.en: Fallen leaves had long been one of the main enemies of the perfect American lawn.
sentences.zh: 落叶长期以来一直是完美美国草坪的主要敌人之一。

sentences.en: At first, this cleanup machine, aka leaf blower, seemed to solve the problem perfectly.
sentences.zh: 起初，这种清理机，也就是吹叶机，似乎完美地解决了这个问题。

sentences.en: A drought-friendly way to move leaves and debris off your yard.
sentences.zh: 一种既节水又能将草坪上的落叶和杂物清理干净的方法。

sentences.en: That commercial shows a person with a backpack engine set up,
sentences.zh: 那则广告展示了一个背着发动机装置的人，

sentences.en: a big hose coming out, blowing leaves across a green lawn.
sentences.zh: 拖着一根大软管，将树叶吹过一片绿色的草坪。

sentences.en: What you can't really tell in that commercial is that these things were loud.
sentences.zh: 你在那则广告里真正无法察觉的是，这些机器声音非常大。

sentences.en: Before the leaf blower, people were using gas-powered lawnmowers, too.
sentences.zh: 在吹叶机出现之前，人们其实也在使用汽油驱动的割草机。

sentences.en: But adding another engine to a full lawn cleanup meant double the noise.
sentences.zh: 但在一场完整的草坪清理工作中再增加一台发动机，意味着噪音翻倍。

sentences.en: By 1989, some estimates say that about one million leaf blowers had sold in America.
sentences.zh: 到1989年，据估计美国大约已经售出了一百万台吹叶机。

sentences.en: But while they were ubiquitous, they were also almost universally hated.
sentences.zh: 但尽管它们无处不在，却也几乎遭到了普遍的厌恶。

sentences.en: This noisy little machine could be used more often than a lawnmower, even daily.
sentences.zh: 这个吵闹的小机器比割草机使用得更频繁，甚至每天都在用。

sentences.en: And some people wouldn't even use it to make leaf piles to bag up and remove.
sentences.zh: 有些人甚至不用它把树叶堆起来装袋处理，

sentences.en: They'd just blow leaves into the street, or in the case of dust, up in the air.
sentences.zh: 而是直接把树叶吹到街上，或者如果是灰尘的话，就吹到空中。

sentences.en: Through the 1980s facing pressure from homeowners and constituents in quiet neighborhoods,
sentences.zh: 在整个20世纪80年代，面对来自安静社区的房主和选民的压力，

sentences.en: many city councils had introduced or passed outright bans on the leaf blower.
sentences.zh: 许多市议会已经提出或通过了彻底禁止吹叶机的法案。

sentences.en: From the start, Californian cities stood at the forefront of the war against the leaf blower.
sentences.zh: 从一开始，加州的城市就站在了反对吹叶机战争的最前沿。

sentences.en: And the most high-profile ban in Southern California was in, you guessed it, Beverly Hills.
sentences.zh: 而南加州最受瞩目的禁令就出在——你猜对了——贝弗利山。

sentences.en: In Southern California, there was a celebrity cast of characters speaking out against the blower.
sentences.zh: 在南加州，有一群反对吹叶机的知名人物代表。

sentences.en: Not exactly household names today, but people who were well-known at the time.
sentences.zh: 虽然今天不算是家喻户晓的名字，但在当时他们都是很有名望的人。

sentences.en: One of the main proponents of the leaf blower ban was Peter Graves,
sentences.zh: 吹叶机禁令的主要倡导者之一是彼得·格雷夫斯，

sentences.en: the main actor in the original Mission Impossible TV show.
sentences.zh: 也就是原版《碟中谍》电视剧中的主演。

sentences.en: Besides leaves and dust, just what do blowers blow?
sentences.zh: 除了树叶和灰尘，吹叶机到底还吹起了什么？

sentences.en: Things better left on the ground.
sentences.zh: 那些原本更应该留在地面的东西。

sentences.en: This is from a PSA that Graves recorded.
sentences.zh: 这段话节选自格雷夫斯录制的一则公益广告。

sentences.en: Pesticides, fertilizers, spores, molds, fecal matter, insects, dangerous chemicals, allergic fungi, and more.
sentences.zh: 杀虫剂、化肥、孢子、霉菌、粪便、昆虫、危险化学品、过敏性真菌等等。

sentences.en: The video shows a man blowing leaves outside of an open window.
sentences.zh: 视频显示一名男子在开着的窗户外面吹树叶。

sentences.en: Just inside, a baby is taking a nap.
sentences.zh: 窗户里面，一个婴儿正在睡午觉。

sentences.en: But for all of their loudness and fumes,
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管它们有那么大的噪音和废气，

sentences.en: the leaf blower was also very fast at removing leaves from a yard.
sentences.zh: 吹叶机在清除院子落叶方面的效率也非常高。

sentences.en: And for the people who were not just maintaining their own lawn, but many lawns,
sentences.zh: 而对于那些不仅要维护自家草坪、还要维护许多草坪的人来说，

sentences.en: the speed was a big deal.
Like a regular small house, maybe half an hour, 45 minutes.
sentences.zh: 就像一个普通的独立小住宅，大概半小时，45分钟。

sentences.en: But a big house, you're going to spend like an hour, two hours.
sentences.zh: 但如果是一个大房子，你得花大约一个小时、两个小时。

sentences.en: And we are at my place on Sunland, California.
sentences.zh: 我们现在在加利福尼亚州桑兰的我家里。

sentences.en: How long have you been a gardener?
I met Jaime in his hilly Southern California neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 我在南加州他那多山的社区里见到了海梅。

sentences.en: Horse tracks marked the mud where a sidewalk should be.
sentences.zh: 本该有人行道的地方，泥地里留下了马蹄的印迹。

sentences.en: Rows of ranch houses, more pastures and native plants than manicured lawns.
sentences.zh: 一排排牧场风格的住宅，比起修剪整齐的草坪，这里更多的是牧场和本土植物。

sentences.en: In 1989, Jaime Alaman left his job and office supplies to start his own landscaping company.
sentences.zh: 1989年，海梅·阿拉曼辞去了工作和办公用品供应的职务，开始创办自己的景观绿化公司。

sentences.en: His father-in-law gave him a handful of clients,
sentences.zh: 他的岳父给了他几个客户，

sentences.en: and he remembers the first time he ever used a leaf blower.
sentences.zh: 他依然记得自己第一次使用吹叶机的情景。

sentences.en: It's a good thing to blow the leaves, and it's faSt.
sentences.zh: 吹树叶是个好办法，而且速度很快。

sentences.en: You do that with a blower, and it looks clean and nice.
sentences.zh: 你用吹叶机做这个，看起来干净又漂亮。

sentences.en: A landscaper often starts their business when an older gardener gives them a few houses or clients.
sentences.zh: 当老园丁把一些房子或客户转交给新手时，园丁通常就这样开启了他们的业务。

sentences.en: Through much of the 20th century, a lot of the gardeners in Los Angeles were of Japanese descent.
sentences.zh: 在整个20世纪的大部分时间里，洛杉矶的许多园丁都是日裔。

sentences.en: But throughout the 80s and 90s, that began to shift to mostly Latin American gardeners.
sentences.zh: 但在整个80和90年代，这一情况开始转变为以拉丁美洲裔园丁为主。

sentences.en: Their circuit of clients became known as La Ruta, the root.
sentences.zh: 他们固定的客户服务圈被称为“拉鲁塔”（La Ruta），意为路线。

sentences.en: The difference between failure and success for a gardener is all about speed.
sentences.zh: 园丁走向失败还是成功，区别全在于速度。

sentences.en: They get paid per lawn, and the margins are already small.
sentences.zh: 他们按草坪数量拿报酬，利润空间本来就很小。

sentences.en: Using a blower instead of a rake means they can work a bigger circuit of lawns in a single day.
sentences.zh: 使用吹叶机而不是耙子意味着他们可以在一天内打理更大片区域的草坪。

sentences.en: But as Jaime began his business and expanding La Ruta, tension had been building for almost a decade.
sentences.zh: 但正当海梅开始创业并扩大“拉鲁塔”路线时，紧张局势已经酝酿了近十年。

sentences.en: Word began to spread through the community that the Los Angeles City Council
sentences.zh: 社区里开始流传消息称，洛杉矶市议会

sentences.en: was seriously considering a ban on gas-powered leaf blowers.
sentences.zh: 正在认真考虑禁止使用汽油驱动的吹叶机。

sentences.en: I remember the whole thing when this thing started.
sentences.zh: 这件事刚开始的时候我都记得。

sentences.en: We were kind of upset because they wanted to take one of the best tools to clean the house.
sentences.zh: 我们当时有点沮丧，因为他们想夺走清理房屋最好的工具之一。

sentences.en: Jaime saw this proposed ban as an obvious threat to his young business.
sentences.zh: 海梅将这项拟议中的禁令视为对他的年轻生意的明显威胁。

sentences.en: And he started to ask around, looking for some advice on how to fight it.
sentences.zh: 于是他开始四处打听，寻求如何对抗这一禁令的建议。

sentences.en: This is actually like a Hollywood story, to tell you the truth.
sentences.zh: 说实话，这其实挺像一个好莱坞故事的。

sentences.en: This is Dr. Alvaro Huerta, associate professor in the Urban and Regional Planning Department of Cal Poly Pomona.
sentences.zh: 这位是波莫纳加州理工大学城市与区域规划系副教授阿尔瓦罗·韦尔塔博士。

sentences.en: But back in 1996, he was a young Chicano activist from Boyle Heights.
sentences.zh: 但在1996年时，他还是来自博伊尔高地的年轻奇卡诺活动家。

sentences.en: Alvaro had a small group of activist friends who took on some big issues,
sentences.zh: 阿尔瓦罗有一群志同道合的活动家朋友，他们承接了一些重大议题，

sentences.en: like getting UCLA to provide financial aid to undocumented students.
sentences.zh: 比如争取让加州大学洛杉矶分校为无身份学生提供经济援助。

sentences.en: One night, around May of 1996, Alvaro was drinking with some friends,
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，大约在1996年5月，阿尔瓦罗正和几个朋友喝酒，

sentences.en: watching a boxing match, when Jaime Aleman came up and confronted him.
sentences.zh: 看着一场拳击比赛，这时海梅·阿莱曼走过来找他理论。

sentences.en: He was like calling me out.
sentences.zh: 他就像是当面质问我一样。

sentences.en: And then he said, you guys act like you're from the raza, the community.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，你们表现得好像你们是拉萨（同胞）、是这个社区的一分子。

sentences.en: But here we are, you know, the jardineros.
sentences.zh: 但我们这些园丁却落到了这般田地，你知道的。

sentences.en: The City Valley wants to take away our leaf blowers and you guys are not doing anything.
sentences.zh: 市议会想要夺走我们的吹叶机，而你们却什么都不做。

sentences.en: Like, what are you going to do for us, you know?
sentences.zh: 就像是，你们打算为我们做点什么，对吧？

sentences.en: Jaime asked Alvaro to take on the fight to save the leaf blower.
sentences.zh: 海梅请求阿尔瓦罗带头进行保卫吹叶机的斗争。

sentences.en: I just said yes, not knowing what I was getting into.
sentences.zh: 我当时就答应了，根本不知道自己将卷入什么事情中。

sentences.en: Pretty quickly, Alvaro and a small group of friends and activists sprung into action.
sentences.zh: 很快，阿尔瓦罗和一小群朋友及活动家便付诸行动。

sentences.en: Since gardeners are independent contractors and self-employed business owners,
sentences.zh: 由于园丁们都是独立承包商和自谋职业的企业主，

sentences.en: this would not be a traditional union labor kind of fight.
sentences.zh: 这不会是一场传统的工会劳工式的斗争。

sentences.en: But they wanted to show that they were united.
sentences.zh: 但他们希望表明他们是团结一致的。

sentences.en: And so, the Association of Latin American Gardeners of Los Angeles, or Alagla, was born.
sentences.zh: 于是，洛杉矶拉丁裔园丁协会（简称Alagla）应运而生。
海梅也立刻加入了进来。

sentences.en: We got together in different areas because there's gardeners all over.
sentences.zh: 我们在不同的地方聚会，因为园丁遍布各处。

sentences.en: So we have meetings here in the Valley, West LA, Hollywood, and all of us.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在山谷地区、西洛杉矶、好莱坞都有开会，我们所有人都在。

sentences.en: Alagla's opponents were no small adversary.
sentences.zh: Alagla的对手可不是什么小角色。

sentences.en: Not only were these leaf blower bands widely popular among non-landscapers and people who enjoy sleep,
sentences.zh: 这些吹叶机禁令不仅在非园丁人群以及喜欢睡觉的人中间大受欢迎，

sentences.en: but this one was about to become law.
sentences.zh: 而且这项禁令眼看就要成为法律。

sentences.en: It seemed that the city council had a lot of momentum.
sentences.zh: 看起来市议会已经掌握了很大的推进势头。

sentences.en: So this bill, it took, let's say, six months, a year to get to that point.
sentences.zh: 所以这个法案，比方说，花了六个月、一年的时间才进展到那个地步。

sentences.en: So we got there like at the 11th hour.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在可以说是最后关头才介入的。

sentences.en: On a spring day of May 1996, not long after Jaime approached Alvaro,
sentences.zh: 在1996年5月的一个春日，就在海梅找过阿尔瓦罗后不久，

sentences.en: the subject of leaf blowers came up in Los Angeles City Hall.
sentences.zh: 吹叶机的话题被搬上了洛杉矶市政厅的议程。

sentences.en: On the balance of the regular agenda, item nine is an ordinance first reading,
sentences.zh: 在常规议程的平衡安排中，第九项是一项条例的一读，

sentences.en: which would prohibit all gas-powered leaf blowers within 500 feet of a residence.
sentences.zh: 该条例将禁止在距离住宅500英尺以内的范围内使用所有汽油驱动的吹叶机。

sentences.en: This is audio from Los Angeles City Council in 1996.
sentences.zh: 这段音频来自1996年的洛杉矶市议会。

sentences.en: The leaf blower ban had been generating a lot of buzz,
sentences.zh: 吹叶机禁令引发了热烈的反响，

sentences.en: and the person championing this effort was council member Marvin Rowdy.
sentences.zh: 而推动这一努力的核心人物是市议员马文·罗迪。

sentences.en: Society is going through many, many changes,
sentences.zh: 社会正在经历许许多多的变化，

sentences.en: and one of those changes is that more people are working in the home.
sentences.zh: 而其中一个变化就是越来越多的人开始在家办公。

sentences.en: Again, this was pre-pandemic, pre-video chat 1990s,
sentences.zh: 再次说明，这是大流行和视频聊天普及之前的1990年代，

sentences.en: but there was a growing number of people working by phone
and running businesses out of their houses.
sentences.zh: 并在家里经营生意的人数正在不断增加。

sentences.en: As council member Browdy put it, the leaf blowers were disruptive.
sentences.zh: 正如罗迪议员所说，吹叶机会造成干扰。

sentences.en: And how we measure that is by the number of complaints that we get,
sentences.zh: 我们衡量这一影响的方式就是根据我们收到的投诉数量，

sentences.en: and we get very, very many.
sentences.zh: 而我们收到的投诉非常非常多。

sentences.en: So he proposed a simple solution.
sentences.zh: 于是他提出了一个简单的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's a one-line ordinance, and it in effect says
sentences.zh: 这是一条单行的条例，其大意是

sentences.en: that gasoline-powered leaf blowers are prohibited.
sentences.zh: 禁止使用汽油驱动的吹叶机。

sentences.en: Though noise seemed to be the animating factor,
sentences.zh: 尽管噪音似乎是主要的驱动因素，

sentences.en: council member Browdy laid out three reasons for the law,
sentences.zh: 但罗迪议员为这项法律列出了三个理由，

sentences.en: which echoed the complaints in other cities.
sentences.zh: 这些理由呼应了其他城市的投诉。

sentences.en: Number one, the sound of leaf blowers.
It drowned out dinners on the back patio.
sentences.zh: 它盖过了后院晚餐时的交谈声。

sentences.en: it woke up the entire neighborhood at 7 a.m.
sentences.zh: 它在星期六早晨七点钟

sentences.en: For decades, Los Angeles had been trying to address air quality issues.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，洛杉矶一直在努力解决空气质量问题。

sentences.en: And leaf blowers were blowing all types of dust and particulate matter into the air,
sentences.zh: 而吹叶机把各种灰尘和颗粒物吹到了空气中，

sentences.en: which is related to reason number three, emissions.
sentences.zh: 这与第三个原因有关，即尾气排放。

sentences.en: Gas-powered leaf blowers run on a small two-stroke engine
sentences.zh: 汽油动力吹叶机使用的是小型二冲程发动机，

sentences.en: that even by 1996 standards was polluting and inefficient.
